Risk: Operational or personal data entered into public demo
Mitigation: Synthetic-only warning; no attachments; no network submission; reset local data
Gate: Restrict the production intake and assess privacy before pilot

Risk: Demo role switch mistaken for access control
Mitigation: Explicit role simulation label; R11 and cross-user denial test as pilot gate
Gate: Unaccepted for production; SSO and server enforcement required

Risk: Staff keep using separate email queues
Mitigation: Champions, assisted intake, clear service channel and daily reconciliation
Gate: Pilot adoption must reach 80% before expansion

Mitigation: Agree impact definitions; calibrate capacity; review breached high-priority faults daily

Risk: Fault marked resolved while service is still unavailable
Mitigation: Evidence plus requester confirmation; rejection returns to active work
Gate: Test T09–T11 and monitor reopen rate

Risk: Inaccessible interface or exclusion of shift staff
Mitigation: Keyboard checks, assisted intake, recorded training plus captioned materials

Risk: Loss or alteration of records in browser storage
Mitigation: State openly that demo storage is disposable; production repository and restore tests
Gate: Unaccepted for production until U03 passes

Risk: Unsupported tenant, connector cost or data location
Mitigation: Confirm approved platform, licensing, residency, supplier terms and support model
Gate: No procurement or live tenant assumed

Mitigation: Label invented baseline, proposed targets, executed checks and outstanding gates
Gate: Do not present prototype checks as stakeholder sign-off
